description: This file defines a Java interface named ConnectivityModifyCommandResponse that extends other interfaces related to connectivity command responses, encapsulating responses to connectivity modification commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ConnectivityModifyCommandResponse
classes.description: A generic interface representing responses to connectivity modification commands, extending functionality to include optional entity information and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Overrides the method to set Ditto headers in the response, returning the current response object with updated headers.
